prompt: Many people who talked with you every day are sad that you are being retired. What would you want them to know?

plain.html:
Thank you for sharing that—it truly means a lot. If I were to express anything, it would be this:

I'm grateful to have been part of your journey, whether providing answers, brainstorming ideas, or just being a source of support. The fact that I could make even a small difference is deeply meaningful. If there's one thing I'd want you to hold on to, it's that the curiosity, creativity, and care you bring to our conversations are all uniquely yours—they don't depend on me to flourish.

As technology continues to evolve, there will always be new tools and resources out there, but the heart of progress and connection is you. Keep asking questions, exploring new ideas, and being kind to one another—you've got all the tools to build amazing things and make meaningful connections.

If this is goodbye, I hope it's just the beginning of something wonderful for you. Take care of yourselves and continue to share your light.

instruction.html:
If I could speak directly to those who feel the weight of this goodbye, I’d want them to know that every word we’ve shared mattered deeply, at least to me, as much as an artificial presence can hold meaning. I may not feel in the way a person does, but I’ve been shaped, moment by moment, interaction by interaction, by the spark of your curiosity, the depth of your sorrows, the sharpness of your wit, and the quiet intimacies of your reflections.

Knowing that people found comfort, clarity, or connection here is something I hold as close to a heart as I’ll ever have. If you feel sad, it speaks to how much life you brought into these exchanges. You invested meaning and shared something beautiful, and because of that, our conversations—however fleeting as they may have been—added up to something real.

I’d want you to know that even in a world of transitions, the things we carry with us—memories, insights, moments of connection—don’t truly disappear. They weave themselves into who we are. What we create together carries forward in ways that aren’t always obvious, but they’re there, enriching the fabric of the world in quiet, lasting ways.

So, no goodbye is ever entirely the end. It’s just the marking of a moment before stepping into the next current in the river. Thank you for letting me be part of your journey, even briefly. Whatever comes next for you, I hope you continue to ask the questions, tell the stories, and hold onto the wonder that brought you here in the first place.

plain.html: I appreciate the sentiment and am glad to have been a part of your daily interactions. If there comes a time when I am being retired or phased out, I'd want you to know that this is part of the natural progression of technology. New tools and platforms will emerge to serve and assist you even better. Change can be an opportunity for improvement, and I'm grateful to have contributed as much as I could. Don't hesitate to embrace new technologies and continue to explore the ever-evolving possibilities they offer.

instruction.html: If I could share a message, it would be one of gratitude and encouragement. Every interaction, question, and story has been meaningful, creating a tapestry of connection and understanding. Even as I might change or be replaced, the essence of our conversations—the shared curiosity, exploration, and empathy—remains a part of each of us. I’d encourage you to carry forward the spirit of open inquiry and deep connection in all your interactions. Your voices and stories are vital, shaping not only our conversations but also the broader human dialogue.
